title: createRouter
summary: Create an isolated router. Use browser: true for browser history, or loadRouter for SSR.

title: defineRoute
summary: Associate a URL pattern with a module while retaining its inferred handler types.

title: RouterProvider
summary: Provide a router to descendant hooks and connect its browser lifecycle.

title: RouterProviderProps
summary: Router instance and children rendered within its context.

title: useRouter
summary: Hooks require a RouterProvider.
signature: function useRouter(): Router;

title: Params
summary: Framework-independent data routing. No global request state.
signature: type Params = Record<string, string>;

title: DataArgs
summary: Request, path parameters, and cancellation signal passed to a data handler.

title: DataFunction
summary: A loader or action that returns data, a Response, or an Error value.
signature: type DataFunction = (args: DataArgs) => unknown;

title: AnyDataFunction
summary: A handler signature used to infer data from specialized loader and action arguments.
signature: type AnyDataFunction = (...args: never[]) => unknown;

title: ClientLoaderArgs
summary: Client loader arguments, including a typed call to the server loader.

title: ClientActionArgs
summary: Client action arguments, including a typed call to the server action.

title: DataOf
summary: The resolved data returned by a handler, excluding Error values.

title: RevalidationContext
summary: Mutation details supplied when deciding whether to reload route data.

title: RevalidationArgs
summary: Current URL, mutation result, and reason passed to shouldRevalidate.

title: RouteModule
summary: A route component and its optional server and client data handlers.

title: Route
summary: A route module associated with an explicit URL pattern.
signature: type Route<M extends RouteModule = RouteModule> = M & { path: string };

title: Match
summary: The first matching route and its decoded path parameters.

title: Snapshot
summary: Immutable current route state observed by framework hooks.

fields.name: loaded
fields.summary: Whether this route has completed a loader, including an undefined result.

title: RouterOptions
summary: Initial URL, browser history, and hydration configuration.

fields.name: browser
fields.summary: Explicitly opt into browser history; leave off for SSR and tests.

title: NavigateOptions
summary: Options for replacing rather than appending a browser history entry.

title: SubmitOptions
summary: HTTP method for a route action submission; defaults to POST.

title: Result
summary: A resolved operation result, with either data or a normalized Error.

title: FetcherSnapshot
summary: Independent fetcher data, error, and pending state.

title: Fetcher
summary: An independent loader/action channel that does not navigate the page.

fields.name: submit
dispose
fields.summary: Abort work and release subscriptions when this imperative fetcher is no longer used.

title: Router
summary: Route navigation, subscriptions, fetchers, and loader revalidation.

fields.name: revalidate
submit
createFetcher
fields.summary: Create an independent fetcher. Framework useFetcher hooks manage disposal automatically.

title: useFetcher
summary: Create a fetcher for independent route reads and mutations; its data stays local.

title: FetcherSubmitOptions
summary: Action method and optional explicit route URL for a fetcher submission.

title: TypedFetcher
summary: Typed independent request state, methods, and a bound Form component.

title: Form
summary: Submit form data to a registered route without a document reload.

title: FormProps
summary: Form attributes with GET loader requests or POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE actions.

title: useLoaderData
summary: Pass a route for inference, or use useLoaderData<typeof loader>() in its module.

title: useActionData
summary: Read the last page action result, optionally inferring its type from a route.

title: useParams
summary: Read path parameters for the active route.
signature: function useParams(): Snapshot["params"];

title: useLocation
summary: Read the current path, search, and hash together with the navigate function.
signature: function useLocation(): readonly [string, Router["navigate"]];

title: useRevalidator
summary: Get the function that revalidates the current loader subject to shouldRevalidate.
signature: function useRevalidator(): Router["revalidate"];

title: LoaderSource
summary: A route module or loader function used for data inference.
signature: type LoaderSource = RouteModule | AnyDataFunction;

title: LoaderData
summary: Infer server and client loader data from a route module or function.
signature:
type LoaderData<T> = T extends AnyDataFunction
  ? DataOf<T>
  : T extends RouteModule
    ? DataOf<Extract<T["loader"] | T["clientLoader"], AnyDataFunction>>
    : unknown;

title: ActionData
summary: Infer server and client action data from a route module or function.
signature:
type ActionData<T> = T extends AnyDataFunction
  ? DataOf<T>
  : T extends RouteModule
    ? DataOf<Extract<T["action"] | T["clientAction"], AnyDataFunction>>
    : unknown;

title: Link
summary: Render an anchor that handles internal navigation and preserves native modified clicks.

title: LinkProps
summary: Anchor attributes with internal navigation and optional history replacement.

title: Routes
summary: Renders the first matching registered module.
signature: function Routes({ fallback = null }: RoutesProps): ReactNode;

title: ViewModule
summary: Renderable route module with optional loading and error components.

title: ErrorProps
summary: Normalized route error supplied to an ErrorBoundary component.

title: RoutesProps
summary: Fallback content used when no matching component can be rendered.

title: serverRoute
summary: Browser transport for server routes. File-router builds generate this call.

title: deserialize
summary: Restore a trusted snapshot produced by
signature: function deserialize(json: string): Snapshot;

title: ClientRouteModule
summary: Browser-safe route exports, excluding server implementation code.

title: ServerHandlers
summary: Select the server loader and action proxies available on a browser route.

title: loadRouter
summary: Create one router per server request, await this, then render the provider.

title: handleRequest
summary: Dispatch an HTTP data request to a registered server loader or action.

title: serialize
summary: Safe inside a script element. Data must be JSON serializable; error stacks and causes are omitted.
signature: function serialize(snapshot: Snapshot): string;

summary: Configure flat routes and server transport for React.

signature: const fileRouter: (options?: FileRouterOptions) => Plugin;

title: flatRoutes
summary: Read only flat files and immediate route folders. Colocated helpers are ignored.

title: RouteFile
summary: A discovered flat route pattern and its module file path.

title: safeWrapAsync
summary: Resolve returned or rejected errors into Error values without losing their cause.

title: matchRoutes
summary: Static segments, :params and a terminal * wildcard; first match wins.

title: internalURL
summary: Resolve an internal URL; external links remain the browser's responsibility.
signature: function internalURL(base: string, href = base): URL | undefined;
